verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਹੁਇ ਮਿਠ ਬੋਲਾ ਲਿਖੈ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: gur sikhee dhaa bolanaa hui miTh bolaa likhai na lekhai|

en.bdb: The Sikh life one speaks mildly and never gets oneself noticed i.e. ego is diated.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਚਲਣਾ ਚਲੈ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਲੀਤੇ ਭੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: gursikhee dhaa chalanaa chalai bhai vich leete bhekhai|

en.bdb: Maintaining the Sikh form and moving in the fear of the Lord constitute the Sikh way of living.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਰਾਹੁ ਏਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਲ ਚਲੈ ਸੋ ਦੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: gursikhee dhaa raahu eh gurmukh chaal chalai so dhekhai|

en.bdb: Sikh living means following the footsteps gursikhs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਾਲਿ ਖਾਇ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਅਵੇਸੁ ਵਿਸੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: ghaal khai sevaa karai gur upadhes aves visekhai|

en.bdb: One should eat the fruit of one's own labour, do service and could always remain inspired by the teachings of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇ ਨ ਅਪੜੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: aap ganai na apaRai aap gavaae roop na rekhai|

en.bdb: The supreme rd is not attained through egotism and only after losing the sense of ego e can identify oneself with the formless and limitless Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਰਦੇ ਵਾਂਗੁ ਮੁਰੀਦ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਰੀ ਵੜਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਲੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: muradhe vaa(n)g mureedh hoi gur goree vaR alakh alekhai|

en.bdb: A disciple coming like a dead person and entering into the guru-grave can merge in at imperceptible Lord who is beyond all writs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਮੰਤੁ ਨ ਸੇਖ ਸਰੇਖੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit_en: a(n)t na ma(n)t na sekh sarekhai ||6||

en.bdb: Sesanags could not derstand the mystery of His mantra.
